theorem snapshotCert_data [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64)
    (snapOk : List LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (k : SnapTrip) : isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗
    snapshotCert γ N k ⊢ ∃ l, isCommittedLogLb γ l ∗ ⌜l.length = uint.nat k.sid.index' ∧ snapOk l
    k.dat⌝

theorem snapshotCert_static [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List
    w64) (snapOk : List LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (l : List LogEntry) (i : w64) (d : List w8) : (∀
    (t : w64), SnapListsOk { sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := { voters := vs, learners :=
    [], outgoing := [], learnersNext := [] }, al := false, dat := d }) → l.length = uint.nat i →
    snapOk l d → isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l ⊢ □ ∀ t, snapshotCert γ N {
    sid := { term' := t, index' := i }, cl := { voters := vs, learners := [], outgoing := [],
    learnersNext := [] }, al := false, dat := d }

theorem cluster_alloc_static [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (snapOk :
    List LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (E : CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → vs ≠ [] → vs.Nodup
    → ¬W64 0 ∈ vs → ↑vs.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 → ⊢ |={E}=> ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = false⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ [] ∗
    ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ isStaticCluster γ N vs snapOk ∗ leaderTransferOn
    γ N ∗ [∗list] id ∈ vs, nodeRestartBoot γ N vs id

theorem node.wp_readyRecv [package_sem : Assumptions] (n ch : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id
    : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) : st.handling = none → ⊢ ∀ Φ, isReadyChan n γ N ch ∗ isNode n γ N
    id ∗ nodeDriver n γ N st -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃ ce es h L, committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries'
    st.delivered.length ce ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗ (∃ rs, readStatesPts
    rd.ReadStates' rs ∗ [∗list] s ∈ rs, readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗ readyRest γ N id
    rd st ce es h L ∗ nodeDriver n γ N (match L with | none => { storage := st.storage, delivered :=
    st.delivered ++ ce, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) } | some l
    => { storage := st.storage, delivered := strip l.dlv, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h,
    handling := some (es, some l) })) -∗ Φ (intoVal rd, intoVal true)) -∗ WP ((chan.receive
    Ready.ty) (intoVal ch)) {{ Φ }}

theorem cluster_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (ps : List w64) (ctxs : List (List
    w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (snapOk : List LogEntry → List w8 → Prop) (transfer : Bool) (E :
    CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^ 61 → BootLog ps
    ctxs boot → ps.Nodup → ps ≠ [] → ¬W64 0 ∈ ps → ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0)
    ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = false⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ ownReadCtxs γ ∅ ∗ readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 -
    2) ∗ isStaticCluster γ N ps snapOk ∗ (if transfer = true then leaderTransferOn γ N else
    leaderTransferOff γ N) ∗ readyFits γ N ∗ [∗list] id ∈ ps, nodeBoot γ N ps ctxs id

def readyRest (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce :
    List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ms,
      entsRO rd.Entries' es ∗
        ownSlice rd.Messages' (List.map QMsg.loc ms) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          ([∗list] q ∈ ms, iprop(msgOwn q.loc (readyDq q.st) q.st ∗ sentMsg γ N id q.st ∗ msgCredits γ N q.st)) ∗
            hsOpt rd.HardState' h ∗
              softStateRO rd.SoftState' ∗
                ⌜∃ Lx,
                      Lx < 2 ^ 64 ∧
                        (∀ (e0 : EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ Lx + 1) ∧
                          ↑(st.delivered ++ ce).length ≤ Lx ∧ Lx < ↑(receiptBound GF) + ↑γ.bootLen⌝ ∗
                  readySnap γ N rd st ce es L)

theorem isReadyChan_recvAu [package_sem : Assumptions] (n ch : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace)
    (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (Φ : Ready → Bool → IProp GF) : st.handling = none → ⊢
    isReadyChan n γ N ch -∗ isNode n γ N id -∗ nodeDriver n γ N st -∗ ∃ γc, isChan ch γc Ready ∗ (£
    1 ∗ £ 1 -∗ (▷ ∀ rd, (∃ ce es h L, committedEntriesAt rd.CommittedEntries' st.delivered.length ce
    ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ (st.delivered ++ ce) ∗ (∃ rs, readStatesPts rd.ReadStates' rs ∗ [∗list] s ∈
    rs, readStateOk γ N s.RequestCtx' s.Index') ∗ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗ nodeDriver n γ
    N (match L with | none => { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered ++ ce, hardState :=
    phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, none) } | some l => { storage := st.storage,
    delivered := strip l.dlv, hardState := phsNext st.hardState h, handling := some (es, some l) }))
    -∗ Φ rd true) -∗ recvAu γc Ready Φ)

theorem sentMsg_replaceSnapshot [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (src :
    w64) (st : MsgSt) (sv sv' : SnapshotM) (c : w64) (l : List LogEntry) (E : CoPset) : ↑N ⊆ E →
    st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → st.snap = some sv → uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z
    sv'.Metadata'.Index' → uint.Z sv'.Metadata'.Index' ≤ uint.Z c → l.length = uint.nat
    sv'.Metadata'.Index' → Option.map LogEntry.term l.getLast? = some sv'.Metadata'.Term' → ⊢
    sentMsg γ N src st -∗ committedAtTerm γ N st.msg.Term' c -∗ isCommittedLogLb γ l -∗ snapshotCert
    γ N (snapTrip sv' sv'.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ={E}=∗ sentMsg γ N src { msg := st.msg, ents
    := st.ents, snap := some sv', ctx := st.ctx, resps := st.resps }

theorem readyRest_fits [go.Semantics] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (rd : Ready) (st :
    NodeDriverState) (ce : List LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (h : HardStateM) (L : Option SnapLoan)
    : readyFits γ N ∗ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ⊢ readyRest γ N id rd st ce es h L ∗ ⌜∀ (e0 :
    EntryM), es.head? = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑es.length ≤ 2 ^ 61⌝

theorem readCtx_commit_after (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (U : GSet (List w8)) (c : List w8) (Q :
    List LogEntry → IProp GF) (l0 : List LogEntry) : ¬c ∈ U → ownReadCtxs γ U ∗ isCommittedLogLb γ
    l0 ∗ □ AU <{ ∃∃ ops, ownCommittedOps γ ops }> @ ⊤ \ ↑N, ∅ <{ ownCommittedOps γ ops, COMM □ Q ops
    }> ⊢ |==> (ownReadCtxs γ (insert c U) ∗ isReadCtx γ N c Q ∗ readCtxAfter γ N c l0)

theorem dynamicCluster_alloc [package_sem : Assumptions] (N : Namespace) (ps : List w64) (ctxs :
    List (List w8)) (boot : List LogEntry) (decode : ConfChangeDecoder) (transfer : Bool) (E :
    CoPset) : receiptBound GF ≤ 2 ^ 64 - 2 → receiptBound GF + boot.length ≤ 2 ^ 61 → BootLog ps
    ctxs boot → ps.Nodup → ps ≠ [] → ¬W64 0 ∈ ps → ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 → ⊢ bootMarshal ps ctxs
    (LogEntry.toEntries boot 0) ={E}=∗ ∃ γ, ⌜γ.dup = false⌝ ∗ ownCommittedOps γ boot ∗ ownReadCtxs γ
    ∅ ∗ readCredits γ (2 ^ 64 - 2) ∗ isDynamicCluster γ N (Membership.simple (listToSet ps)) decode
    ∗ (if transfer = true then leaderTransferOn γ N else leaderTransferOff γ N) ∗ readyFits γ N ∗
    [∗list] id ∈ ps, nodeDynamicBoot γ N ps ctxs id

theorem stepIn_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (ml : Loc)
    (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) : (st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgProp → NetMsgOk id { msg := st.msg, ents :=
    st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := [] } ∧ st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgTransferLeader) →
    (st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → ∃ sv, st.snap = some sv ∧ uint.Z sv.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61) →
    st.msg.To' = id → sentMsg γ N src st ∗ msgPtsC ml (DFrac.own 1) (DFrac.own 1) true { msg :=
    st.msg, ents := st.ents, snap := st.snap, ctx := st.ctx, resps := [] } ∗ msgCredits γ N st ⊢
    |==> stepIn γ N id ml

    Storage) : ((□ ∀ k E, ⌜↑N ⊆ E⌝ -∗ storCert st k ={E}=∗ snapshotCert γ N k) ∗ □ ∀ k E, ⌜↑N ⊆ E⌝
    -∗ snapshotCert γ N k ={E}=∗ storCert st k) ⊢ storageCertLink γ N st

theorem Membership.applyChange_removeVoter (vs : GSet w64) (cm : ConfChangeM) : cm.type = W32 1 →
    cm.nodeId ≠ W64 0 → cm.nodeId ∈ vs → GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs ≠ ∅ → (Membership.simple vs).Valid
    → Membership.applyChange (ConfChangeIM.v1 cm) (Membership.simple vs) = some (Membership.simple
    (GMap.delete cm.nodeId vs))

def (sealed) isStaticCluster (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (vs : List w64) (snapOk : List LogEntry →
    List w8 → Prop) : IProp GF

theorem readySnap_dynamic [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c0 :
    Membership) (decode : ConfChangeDecoder) (rd : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce : List
    LogEntry) (es : List EntryM) (l : SnapLoan) : isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗ readySnap γ N rd
    st ce es (some l) ⊢ False

theorem msgCredits_snapshot [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (st : MsgSt) :
    st.msg.Type' = MsgSnap → ⊢ |==> msgCredits γ N st

theorem msgCredits_none (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (st : MsgSt) : st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgReadIndex →
    st.msg.Type' ≠ MsgProp → ⊢ |==> msgCredits γ N st

theorem sentMsg_persistent (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (src : w64) (st : MsgSt) : Persistent
    (sentMsg γ N src st)

theorem nodeDriver_hardStateCommitted [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N :
    Namespace) (c0 : Membership) (decode : ConfChangeDecoder) (st : NodeDriverState) :
    isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗ nodeDriver n γ N st ⊢ nodeDriver n γ N st ∗ (⌜st.hardState =
    hsZero⌝ ∨ committedAtTerm γ N st.hardState.Term' st.hardState.Commit' ∗ ⌜↑st.delivered.length ≤
    uint.Z st.hardState.Commit'⌝)

def readySnap (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (rd : Ready) (st : NodeDriverState) (ce : List LogEntry)
    (es : List EntryM) : Option SnapLoan → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => iprop(⌜rd.Snapshot' = null⌝ ∗ appendRight st.storage es)
  | some l =>
    iprop(⌜l.dlv = LogEntry.toEntries (strip l.dlv) 0 ∧
            l.ptr = rd.Snapshot' ∧
              ce = [] ∧
                st.delivered <+: strip l.dlv ∧
                  st.delivered.length < l.dlv.length ∧
                    l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                      0 < uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧
                        uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' < 2 ^ 61 ∧
                          uint.Z l.fl ≤ uint.Z l.snap.Metadata'.Index' ∧ LogIndicesOk (snapId l.snap) es⌝ ∗
        ownSnapS l.ptr (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) l.snap ∗
          isCommittedLogLb γ (strip l.dlv) ∗
            snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ∗ readyOut st.storage es (some l))

theorem isDynamicCluster_persistent (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c0 : Membership) (decode :
    ConfChangeDecoder) : Persistent (isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode)
